name: Kaiden Hammond
source:
Kaiden is a knight of the 7th Knight Devision.
He was born into the slums and was adopted by the knight Marco.
Gentlemanly, considered and kind. 
He is the perfect knight who is on a mission to supress cursed beings.
Kaiden is greatly respected by the Myths and commoners.
